# MongoDB

A bot using **MongoDB** and TypeScript for flexible data storage.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://www.mongodb.com/" title="MongoDB" description="Document database." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/mongodb-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Configure MongoDB connection in `.env`:

```bash
MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/mybot
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- MongoDB integration
- Connection pooling
- TypeScript models
- Flexible document storage

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
